name: TYC 6878-195-1
description: A star 1.37 solar radii and 1.17 solar masses that turns once in 5.7 days; its magnetic field has been mapped.

radius.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: radius 1.37 solar radii

mass.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: mass 1.17 solar masses

temperature.source: Pecaut & Mamajek (2013, ApJS 208, 9), the online table's version 2022.04.16, row K4V, for SIMBAD's spectral type K4V(e): Teff

spin.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: rotation period 5.7 d and an axis 68 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with

text.card: A star 1.4 times the Sun's width that turns once in 5.7 days, with a mapped magnetic field.
text.introduction: Folsom et al. give it 1.37 solar radii, 1.17 solar masses, a rotation period of 5.7 days and an axis tilted 68° from the line of sight.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 6764026419748892160 (quality A), from 2021MNRAS.506..150B; Gaia DR3 measures none
